title: Lateral Ankle Ligament Sprain Illustration (Smart-Servier)
author: Laboratoires Servier
caption: Medical illustration demonstrating inversion injury and tearing of the lateral ankle ligaments (anterior talofibular and calcaneofibular ligaments).
alt_text: Diagram showing lateral ankle ligament sprain mechanism.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates lateral ankle sprain mechanism, the most common lower extremity sprain in crewmember training and post-flight recovery (CLIFF-047, p.1, p.3).
